`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0) begin : fast_256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_selected;
        wire [15:0] low_terms [3:0];
        genvar g, j, b;

        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [15:0] x;
            wire [15:0] local_winner;
            wire [3:0] local_code;

            assign x = input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            assign group_valid[g] = |x;
            if (g == 15) begin : highest_group
                assign group_selected[g] = group_valid[g];
            end else begin : lower_group
                assign group_selected[g] = group_valid[g] &
                                           ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end

            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : positions
                if (j == 15) begin : highest_position
                    assign local_winner[j] = x[j];
                end else begin : lower_position
                    assign local_winner[j] = x[j] & ~(|x[15:j+1]);
                end

                if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : zero_fallback
                    // Index zero wins both for input 1 and for input 0.
                    assign output_unencoded[0] = ~(|input_unencoded[255:1]);
                end else if (g == 15) begin : top_output
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = local_winner[j];
                end else begin : other_output
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = local_winner[j] &
                                                     ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
                end
            end

            assign local_code[0] = |(local_winner & 16'haaaa);
            assign local_code[1] = |(local_winner & 16'hcccc);
            assign local_code[2] = |(local_winner & 16'hf0f0);
            assign local_code[3] = |(local_winner & 16'hff00);

            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : code_terms
                assign low_terms[b][g] = local_code[b] & group_selected[g];
            end
        end

        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : low_code
            assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms[b];
        end
        assign output_encoded[4] = |(group_selected & 16'haaaa);
        assign output_encoded[5] = |(group_selected & 16'hcccc);
        assign output_encoded[6] = |(group_selected & 16'hf0f0);
        assign output_encoded[7] = |(group_selected & 16'hff00);
        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    end else begin : original_parameters
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded;
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        assign input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The supplied mapped STA paths establish a 2.60 ns maximum arrival at several one-hot outputs. They share a reduction-like NAND/NOR cone, a buf_12, and a mux2i_4 with 0.58 ns incremental delay, followed by an o2111a_4 with 0.47 ns incremental delay and two additional gates. Together with the original encoded-then-shift architecture, this supports investigating priority selection followed by encoded-signal distribution and one-hot decoding. The buffer and large downstream cell delays suggest a loading/distribution cost, but do not by themselves establish exact fanout or an exact RTL-to-cell correspondence.",
  "rewrite": "Use sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local highest-set one-hot winners directly using suffix reductions, and independently determine which group has highest priority. Produce one-hot outputs by inhibiting each local winner when any higher group is valid, avoiding an encoded-to-one-hot decode. Form encoded bits with masked OR reductions of local winner codes and selected groups. Implement output_unencoded[0] directly as the NOR of input bits 255:1, preserving the required all-zero result without putting a valid-dependent fallback mux on all outputs. Retain the original implementation for parameter configurations outside the optimized instance.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Hypothesis, not a measurement: removing the shared encode-then-decode dependency could reduce maximum arrival by roughly 10–25% relative to 2.60 ns. Group-valid loading, suffix-reduction factoring, and the low encoded-bit reduction paths may instead limit the result. Only the specified Yosys/ABC mapping and OpenSTA run can establish a timing improvement.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Area is unmeasured. The candidate removes the global encoded-to-one-hot decoder but adds local winner logic, group suffix inhibition, and masked encoding reductions. Shared group-valid reductions offer an area-saving opportunity; buffering or duplicated reduction logic could consume it. Acceptance requires mapped area at or below 8862.124480 um^2, full functional equivalence, and zero max-slew and max-capacitance violations under the supplied flow. None of those tool checks has been performed here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "The optimized branch applies to WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0. For every nonzero binary input, exactly the highest set index survives the local and group inhibition; its index is emitted in output_encoded and its one-hot value in output_unencoded. For all-zero input, all encoded reduction terms are zero, output_valid is zero, and only output_unencoded[0] is one. Module name, ports, widths, original parameter names and defaults are retained. The circuit is purely combinational, with no clocks, state, restrictions, assumptions, or don't-cares. Formal equivalence must compare every output bit even when output_valid=0; the requested proof scope is the fixed parameter instance."
}
